name: Hishia Mori
source:
Hobbies: Taking out the trash, trash-talking
Skills: If it's edible, she'll eat it
Likes: Japanese cars
Dislikes: People who come late

[url=/c17297]Shinri's[/url] loveable personal maid. Despite her very obviously Japanese name, she's very clearly not Japanese herself. She has a foul mouth and treats her master in ways unthinkable of a normal maid, but in truth she secretly cares deeply for Shinri... probably.

Follows all of Shinri's orders impeccably and can handle anything from household chores to corporate management with ease; she's the ultimate super-maid. Has a pair of tremendous torpedoes latched to her chest, which pleases Shinri greatly.

"Hellooooooo, can you hear me, Master? I'm afraid that if you keep ignoring me, I'll be forced to stick a custom-made magical torture wand right up your ass."

[Edited from [url=https://hello.nekonyansoft.com/chara.html]official English page[/url]]
